label: Counting triangles and edges
subgoals: Count the points and the hull points
Apply 2n minus 2 minus h for the triangles
Apply 3n minus 3 minus h for the edges

label: The incircle test
subgoals: Translate the three triangle vertices by the query point
Fill each row with the coordinates and the squared distance
Read the sign of the determinant as inside or outside

label: Refining a mesh
subgoals: Confirm the inserted points are strictly inside the hull
Add two triangles and three edges per interior point
Recompute the totals from the new point count
